named_by_text: each code span of the prohibitions section is looked up in the scan and on disk
note: Every code span on the lines of every prohibitions section; a span counts when it has no command characters and holds a slash, a glob or a dot, or names something that exists. Existence is checked in the scan and on disk. In a section opened by its body alone, only the spans of a list item or paragraph that holds a prohibition line count.
The prohibitions-section code spans of CON-01, read like ignore entries, against every folder segment named test, tests or __tests__ in the scan plus those folders at the root on disk.
The top-level scratch and agent-state folders in the scan or on disk, the tracked files under them, and the ignore rules as DOC-03 reads them.
threshold: every present folder ignored and untracked

note: Only paths are read, never content: each scanned file is sorted into secrets, migrations, generated, tests, infrastructure as code and production by name and folder. With --emit-baseline it writes do-not-do.draft.md beside the report, never inside the target; else UNKNOWN.
